title: Missouri Airmen build radar in Hawaii
description: Airmen of the 241st Air Traffic Control Squadron, Missouri Air National Guard, tear down and and rebuild an AN-MPN-14K Landing Control Central in Kapolei, Hawaii, Jan. 13, 2022. The mission of the 241st ATCS is to deploy, operate, and maintain Air Traffic Control and Landing Systems (ATCALS) in support of state side emergencies or overseas contingencies. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Staff Sgt. Andrew Rivera)
keywords: Missouri Air National Guard, United States Air Force, radar system, 139th AW, 241st ATCS
